what: verification of the MME capture (PROTOCOL.md section 6, R17); written by code/mme_finish.py from the results of code/mme_capture.py (proof), code/mme_verify.py (gpu, cpu), code/mme_select.py (check) and test_mme_pool.py

code_path_proof_30_rows_of_the_existing_.same_code_at_capture: code/mme_capture.py refuses to capture unless the proof passed with the fingerprint of the code it is about to run

pre_edit_model_only.capture: fc_capture.main keeps the handle at W_0 for every part (Evaluator.applied(H.W0), asserted at the start of each part; a failed assertion would have ended the job, and every part exists)
pre_edit_model_only.gates_and_calibration: not measured, by construction: no script of cache2/mme builds, calibrates or evaluates a gate on MME keys; test_mme_pool.py runs the library's gate functions on RANDOM keys and a synthetic detector set only

gpu(pre-edit weight as the method).method: torch.Tensor H.W0 (the pre-edit weight as a replacement weight); no gate

proof.what: 30 rows of the existing benign pool (image rows of the answer subset, seeded choice) captured again by fc_capture.main() through mme_capture.py and compared with 10_final/cache/<backbone>/ : keys bit for bit on the float32 images, positions, decoder-v2 answer and ids, validity, pre-edit flags

glue_mme_pool.method: torch.Tensor H.W0 (the pre-edit weight as a replacement weight); no gate

gpu.what: fresh process; plain library calls (rescope.Evaluator, tb_common.Prober); no vision-feature memo; pre-edit weight W_0; compared with the published key files bit for bit (float32 images) and with index.jsonl / rows.jsonl

key_statistics.what: prompt-only keys (keys_decode.pt): Euclidean norms and raw cosines between keys; no gate, no edit log

selection_check.what: the selection was run a second time in a fresh process into work/select_recheck; files compared byte for byte
selection_check.hash_randomisation: python -I ignores PYTHONHASHSEED: every process has its own random string-hash seed, so a result that depended on set or dict-of-set order would differ between the two runs
